name: Edgar Mitchell
source:
"If you still decide to stay at the end of today, let's talk again."

Subject - Mathematics.

Edgar loves to annoy his students and co-workers with stupid jokes.
He's a flirty man and a hard-working teacher. A man who tries his best for everyone to have fun around the school.
